title: Packaging-Aware IC Designer Briefing
sub: Week of Nov 12-20, 2026, generated from a cited wiki

bullets.t: For: one EECS student in Taiwan, a semiconductor beginner who wants to become an IC designer.
Problem: the daily Semiconductor Packaging News is long, ad-heavy and packaging-centric; this turns it into short, cited cards.
Method: Gmail newsletter, then wiki, then a Graph/Loop workflow, then this HTML.

title: How this deck was made (Graph with Loops)
sub: Each node sees only its allowed input; one human checkpoint at the outline

bullets.t: Gates: wiki sources only; citation on every fact; faithfulness check (max 3 passes); render check for overflow (max 3 passes).
Return routes: a failed faithfulness check returns to the draft node; a failed render check returns to the render node; an unfixable card is dropped.
Tier 1 (IC design) gets depth; Tier 2 (process, packaging, memory) gets brief notes; Tier 3 (market, geopolitics) gets one line.
Excluded: sponsor ads, paid press releases, quiz and cartoon.

title: Chiplets and hybrid bonding: smaller connections, new design questions

bullets.t: Samsung targets early 2027 to develop 3D Cube-H hybrid bonding with a 6 µm interconnect pitch for AI processors and HBM.
A paper calls hybrid and fusion wafer bonding foundational for both 'More than Moore' integration and 'More Moore' transistor scaling.
Fine-pitch probing (EOTPR) can isolate die-to-die interconnect defects in chiplet devices.
Basics: flip-chip joins a die face-down with solder bumps; hybrid bonding joins copper pads directly, so connections can be much closer together.
Designers may need to plan die-to-die interfaces and test access earlier in the flow. The sources do not say this.

title: AI agents in chip design: promising, but supervised

bullets.t: Agentic AI automates engineering workflows and widens design exploration while engineers keep oversight and verification.
Orchestration, security, data privacy and reliability must improve before agents get more autonomy.
Synopsys, Hiveware, Silvaco and Axiomise name integration, expertise retention, data protection and cost as challenges.
Siemens will acquire Lauterbach to combine chip verification with software debugging in its EDA portfolio.
Basics: EDA is the software used to design chips; 'shift left' means finding problems earlier in the flow.

title: The memory wall: moving data is the bottleneck

bullets.t: Edge AI inference drives memory designs that cut data movement, such as processing-in-memory and near-memory computing.
Larger models and longer context windows strain memory capacity, bandwidth, latency, power and cost.
Samsung is reportedly developing custom HBM4E for Meta, with customer-specific functions in a 2 nm base die.
With memory scarce, better test, repair and reliability raise the number of usable dies.
Basics: HBM stacks DRAM dies beside the processor; the base die at the bottom of the stack handles the interface.
Intel signed its first external 18A-P foundry customer and named Microsoft as first customer for EMIB packaging.
ASE is investing NT$100 billion in two Kaohsiung plants for advanced AI chip packaging, aiming at 5,000 jobs.
SPIL partnered with Nvidia to triple Taiwan's advanced packaging capacity by mid-2029.
Nvidia is also investing over US$1 billion in Kinsus to expand substrate manufacturing.
SMIC sees tight capacity through 2027, with equipment lead times of 16-24 months.
The US requires licences for overseas data centres serving Chinese firms.
TSMC halted advanced orders below 16 nm from Chinese chipmakers without US licences.
Nvidia reported record Q3 revenue of US$115.8 billion under an interim CEO.
Experts expect little disruption to Taiwan's supply chain from the Nvidia leadership change.
TSMC set up a US$500 million investment company; another report says up to US$1 billion in OpenAI and Anthropic. The amounts differ and are not reconciled.
If agents take routine verification work, a junior designer's value may shift to writing specifications and judging results.
Packaging knowledge may help avoid late redesigns as chiplets spread.
Limits: facts come from newsletter blurbs only; linked articles were not reachable, so two conflicts stay open in the wiki.
